content.title: Blue Ridge Bankshares (BRBS) Losses Worsen, Premium Valuation Challenges Recovery Narratives
content.summary: Blue Ridge Bankshares (BRBS) remains unprofitable, posting average annual losses that widened by 54.7% per year over the past five years. The company’s net profit margin stays in negative territory, with recent results failing to deliver high-quality earnings. With a Price-to-Book Ratio of 1.1x, which is higher than both its peer average of 0.9x and the U.S. banks industry average of 1.0x, the stock trades at a premium despite ongoing operational challenges and a lack of positive reward...

content.title: Blue Ridge Bankshares approves $15M share repurchase program
content.summary: Blue Ridge Bankshares (BRBS) announced that its Board of Directors has adopted a share repurchase program. Pursuant to the Repurchase Program, the Company may purchase up to $15M of the Company’s issued and outstanding shares of common stock. Repurchases may be made in open market purchases, block trades, or privately negotiated transactions.
